purpose: Evaluate the reference-producing semantic judge on official sample action/type labels, not fit final-score offsets or alter prior frozen reviews.
judge_input: Original message input columns and relevant official context/media, with all five labelled output columns removed. No candidate outputs, prior reviews, official final scores, target-category grades, or sample gold labels.
judge_output: One independent action and message_type for each assessable case, concise rationale and hash-bound context references. Unsupported/uninterpreted media yields explicit unknown, never fabricated transcript or forced label.
method: Use one fresh native model reviewer with no inherited study history or target labels in its task.
Freeze the complete prediction artifact and its SHA before comparing with the separately held sample labels.
Compare exact action and message_type strings by message_id, not by position or ID suffix.
Report per-field accuracy, joint exact match, confusion counts, reviewed/unknown/total coverage and per-case disagreements.
Unknowns are excluded from reviewed-case accuracy with coverage explicit; all-case lower/upper accuracy bounds describe missing decisions, not model uncertainty.
No rerun, cap/weight change or selection of a preferred sample result after reading disagreement labels.
If errors reveal an actionable rule-interpretation issue, document it and propose a separately versioned revision; do not silently overwrite this baseline.
limits: This is a public30-row development sample, not a secret or statistically representative holdout.
The project has prior knowledge of official entrant totals and earlier case reviews; the new reviewer input withholds the sample labels, but pretraining/public-data exposure is not controlled.
Action/type decision accuracy does not validate reason quality, evidence relevance, confidence calibration, multimodal correctness, adversarial aggregation or final category points.
There are no candidate predictions for these30 rows in this audit; it evaluates the judge as an independent decision/reference producer, not a live candidate or official-score predictor.
